help-us-presentation: To get as representative a study as possible, we need as much data as we can. To help us, please share this form!
home-presentation: The purpose of this questionnaire is to map and present student poverty. The aim is both to inform each student of the level of poverty they face and to quantify this poverty on a large scale.
home-spoler: This form will only take you 5 minutes to complete and will help us highlight the situation students are facing.

joined-us-presentation: We'll contact you as soon as possible!
new-qr-code-help: This text will help us know the origin of these responses

share-presentation: Here you can share the form with all the students you know 🤗

thank-presentation: We defend students daily, and the more data we have the better we can highlight the difficulties students face. This form is very valuable to us 🤗
welcome-in-pap-description: Here you can manage and create QR codes for occasions where they are needed, for example tonight's door-to-door campaign 🤗
not-obligatory: This information is only used to verify that you do not already have an account. No data is transmitted to any third party. The data will be deleted at the end of the investigation, unless you have chosen to help us.
data-explication: The data submitted is anonymized. The information requested is for statistical purposes only; no data is shared with any third party. The data will be deleted at the end of the survey, unless you have chosen to continue participating.
no-name-no-data: For a survey to be statistically valid, it's essential to ensure that users don't complete the questionnaire multiple times. To integrate your results, fill in the fields above. Otherwise, you can click the button below.
